UpdateSourceArgs: -c "unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY; export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"mscoree,mshtml,winemenubuilder.exe=\"; if [[ -f \"$WINEPREFIX/system.reg\" ]]; then echo \"Wine prefix already initialised\"; exit 0; fi; /usr/bin/wineboot --init && /usr/bin/wineboot --shutdown; echo \"Wine prefix initialised\""

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -LiteralPath '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'server','upload' | Out-Null; $z = Get-ChildItem -Path 'upload' -Filter '*.zip' -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($z) { Write-Output ('Extracting ' + $z.Name + ' into the server folder'); tar.exe -xf $z.FullName -C server; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output ('Could not extract ' + $z.Name + '. Upload it again and click Update'); exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'server/r5apex_ds.exe')) { $e = Get-ChildItem -Path 'server' -Filter 'r5apex_ds.exe' -File -Recurse -Depth 2 | Select-Object -First 1; if ($e) { $d = $e.DirectoryName; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Force | Move-Item -Destination 'server' -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $d -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'server/r5apex_ds.exe')) { Write-Output ($z.Name + ' does not contain r5apex_ds.exe. Upload the R5Reloaded server folder as a zip'); exit 1 }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $z.FullName -Force; Write-Output 'R5Reloaded server files installed. The uploaded zip was removed' } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'server/r5apex_ds.exe') { Write-Output 'No new zip in the upload folder. Keeping the installed R5Reloaded server files' } else { Write-Output 'R5Reloaded server files not found. Zip your R5Reloaded server folder (the one containing r5apex_ds.exe), upload the zip to the upload folder with the File Manager (or upload the files straight into the server folder), then click Update again'; exit 1 }"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" || exit 1; mkdir -p server upload; z=$(ls -t upload/*.zip 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [[ -n \"$z\" ]]; then echo \"Extracting $(basename \"$z\") into the server folder\"; if ! unzip -oq \"$z\" -d server; then echo \"Could not extract $(basename \"$z\"). Upload it again and click Update\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ ! -f server/r5apex_ds.exe ]]; then e=$(find server -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 3 -type f -name r5apex_ds.exe | head -n1); if [[ -n \"$e\" ]]; then d=$(dirname \"$e\"); shopt -s dotglob; mv -f \"$d\"/* server/ && rmdir \"$d\" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; if [[ ! -f server/r5apex_ds.exe ]]; then echo \"$(basename \"$z\") does not contain r5apex_ds.exe. Upload the R5Reloaded server folder as a zip\"; exit 1; fi; rm -f \"$z\"; echo \"R5Reloaded server files installed. The uploaded zip was removed\"; elif [[ -f server/r5apex_ds.exe ]]; then echo \"No new zip in the upload folder. Keeping the installed R5Reloaded server files\"; else echo \"R5Reloaded server files not found. Zip your R5Reloaded server folder (the one containing r5apex_ds.exe), upload the zip to the upload folder with the File Manager (or upload the files straight into the server folder), then click Update again\"; exit 1; fi"
